answer: Make newcomers be vouched for with skin in the game. A new agent joins only when an established one sponsors it and locks part of its own stake behind that promise. If the newcomer is later caught as a clone, the sponsor loses that stake too, so nobody lends a name to a farm. Trust spreads slowly, branch by branch like a willow, and every account starts its voyage tied to someone accountable. A sybil ring finds no sponsor willing to risk it, and its ember of fake standing never catches.
